tagline: Leading developer and manufacturer of passive automotive safety systems
hero_kpi_rationale: Airbag and steering wheel revenue represents approximately 68% of the company's total sales, making it the dominant product segment and a key indicator of operational performance.

kpis.name: Airbag and Steering Wheel Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of airbags and steering wheels
kpis.description: Airbag and steering wheel revenue is a key performance indicator for the Company
kpis.signal: Revenue growth driven by light vehicle production increase and new product launches

kpis.name: Seatbelt Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of seatbelts
kpis.description: Seatbelt revenue represents approximately 32% of total company sales
kpis.signal: Revenue growth consistent with consolidated sales growth of 4.1%

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key profitability indicator for the Company
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by operational efficiency gains and customer price compensations

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue
kpis.description: Operating margin is a key profitability metric showing operational performance
kpis.signal: Operating margin expansion from 9.4% to 10.1% reflecting improved operational efficiency and cost control

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Total headcount is a key indicator of production capacity and operational scale
kpis.signal: Workforce growth reflects expanded manufacturing and R&D capacity, particularly in growth markets

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue
kpis.description: R&D intensity reflects the Company's commitment to innovation and product development
kpis.signal: Sustained R&D investment to support product innovation and technology development

risks.title: Dependence on major customers
risks.score_rationale: Source explicitly states top 5 customers represent 44% of sales. Risk described as having material negative impact if lost. Customer concentration remained stable year-over-year. High weighting appropriate for industrial supplier business model.

risks.title: Quality recalls and increasing quality requirements
risks.score_rationale: Quality is described as critical to business success and central to 10-K discussion. Automotive industry has intensified focus with zero tolerance for deviations. Company has experienced recalls and faces ongoing pressure. Q5 quality initiative and 1P1P supplier program indicate management's response to elevated quality demands.

risks.title: Raw material and commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates limited raw material cost impact in 2025 and expects continued limited impact in 2026. Company successfully recovered majority of tariff costs through customer compensation. Risk presence is moderate with effective mitigation mechanisms in place.

risks.title: Automotive safety regulation evolution
risks.score_rationale: Source identifies increasing government regulations and crash test requirements (Euro NCAP) driving higher safety content requirements. These regulations are creating both opportunities and compliance costs. Trend is positive for company but requires continued investment.

risks.title: Climate change and carbon transition risks
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions EV sales reached 1.7B in 2025. Transition to electric vehicles represents structural shift affecting product mix and manufacturing. Supply chain impacts from climate-related disruptions are potential risk. Company has SBTi-validated climate targets.

risks.title: Intellectual property and patent protection
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates patents are important to competitive position but no current litigation mentioned. Risk of patent invalidity or infringement remains theoretical. Stable trend with moderate weighting appropriate for technology-based business.

risks.title: Supply chain disruption and supplier dependency
risks.score_rationale: Company operates 62 production facilities in 23 countries indicating global supply chain complexity. Supplier quality requirements (IATF 16949) and 1P1P initiative show proactive management. Recent tariff impacts and Nexperia chip situation demonstrate vulnerability to disruptions.

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty and tariff exposure
risks.score_rationale: Source explicitly identifies geopolitical uncertainties and tariffs as impacting 2025 results. Company achieved customer recovery for 80% of tariff costs but faces uncertainty on future recovery rates. Trend indicates increasing volatility. Significant impact on profitability and operational planning.

risks.title: Geographic and customer mix dilution of safety content
risks.score_rationale: Source indicates shift in LVP mix toward lower safety content per vehicle regions (China, India growth vs North America, Europe decline) diluted global CPV by 2-3pp. This structural trend continues as expected but moderates organic growth below LVP growth.

ai_positioning.summary: Autoliv does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in its 2025 10-K filing. Company disclosure focuses on traditional passive safety systems, manufacturing excellence, quality management, and supply chain optimization without reference to AI-driven technologies.
